selection: First up to three upstream intervals per role with duration 4–20 seconds, at least five whitespace-delimited reference words and no annotation tags; at least one per role required; fixed before any model inference.
changes: Mono 16kHz PCM16; utterance crops with 250ms padding; references unchanged.
limitations: Public mock consultations, selected clean utterances, separate speaker channels
New groups relative to the project screening set; speaker independence and model-training independence are not established
No prompt changes, model tuning, reference editing or exclusions based on inference results
